description: Today's AI token prices by company: each company's price index in USD per 1M tokens at the mix of tokens agents send (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output), weighted by its models' usage, with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes and its price trend over 13 weeks (direction, strength, score, speed per month) and its rank by the trend's strength, the order of the home page's list and of this one (sort and order give another: the cheapest first, the largest 1-month change first). Give one company to also get its models' usage shares and posted input, cached input and output prices, and its estimated spend on OpenRouter. For one model's prices use get_model_prices; for past values get_price_history. For questions like "what does Claude cost per 1M tokens?" or "which AI company's API is cheapest?".

company.description: One company; omit for all listed companies.

order.description: With sort: "asc" for the smallest first (name: A to Z; rank: 1 up), "desc" for the largest first. Without it: rank and name ascending, the others largest first, as the page's headers start.

sort.description: The order of the list's rows, as pressing a column header on the home page orders them: rank (the page's own order, its #, by trend strength), name (A to Z), or price, change_1d, change_1w, change_1m or trend (the signed trend score), each largest first. E.g. sort "price", order "asc": the cheapest company first; sort "change_1m": the largest 1-month rise first. A row without the value comes last.

name: get_token_prices

age_hours.description: Hours from updated to this answer. updated is when the token file was last written, at each of the site's updates; the values are those of date, each UTC day's calculated once, after it ends

change_1d_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 1 to 4 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1m_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 30 to 37 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1w_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 7 to 10 days earlier (none: interpolated)

errata.description: Errors found in its final values: for one GPU or company, the last year's, as its page notes them under its value; in the list, those in the values its row gives (its latest, and the bases of its changes, which are changes of the values as published). As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

models.description: Its models in the index: those in OpenRouter's daily top 50, as its page lists them

price.description: The model's price at the mix, USD per 1M tokens

usage_share.description: Share of the company's tokens among its models in OpenRouter's daily top 50 (0 to 1): the index's weight

price.description: Latest index value, USD per 1M tokens at the mix (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output)

trend.description: Its price trend over 13 weeks, as the home page's Trend column and # show it

direction.description: The arrow: rising, falling, or flat at a score of 0.0

per_month_pct.description: The trend line's speed per month, percent

rank.description: The home page's #: its place by trend strength among those listed, strongest first, rising or falling

score.description: The slope of a least-squares line through the logarithms of the index on 13 dates a week apart, over its standard error; negative when falling; none with less than 12 weeks of history

strength.description: strong: a score of 4 or more either way; moderate: 2 to 4; weak: under 2

fields.description: One company's: what its models and their figures are

not_listed.description: The list's: the index's companies not listed today, as on no list of the site (each needs a price, a month of history and a value for each change)

sorted_by.description: The order of the rows, when sort or order asked for another than the home page's own

updated.description: When the token prices were last calculated (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: AI token prices
